claims.statement: Let Y be a Banach space admitting a norm-one projection P:Y**->J_Y(Y). If every finite boundary restriction f|A, A finite subset of S, has a global extension F_A:X->Y with Lip(F_A)<=K Lip(f), then every f:S->Y has a global extension F:X->Y with the same bound. No separability of X or S is required.
assumptions: S is nonempty; the empty-boundary case is trivial
The finite-stage extensions are defined on all of X and have one uniform K
P fixes the canonical copy J_Y(Y) and is contractive
claims.status: internally proved conditional theorem; compactness argument standard; independent audit found no gap
claims.novelty_boundary: The bidual retraction globalization is explicitly in Mendel-Naor's 2013 extension-theorem discussion. No novelty claim. The contribution is application to the finite-range ambient-L1 premise and removal of its separability limitation.

costs.computation: Nonconstructive Tychonoff/Alaoglu compactness and bidual projection; no effective algorithm or representation is supplied
costs.model_premise: Uniform finite-range extension constant K must be established separately

claims.falsifier: A failure of weak*-closedness of a bidual norm ball, cofinal preservation of each boundary value, or the asserted contractive retraction would invalidate the proof; none occurs under the listed assumptions.
claims.next_gate: Obtain and independently verify the finite-stage theorem and establish whether the arbitrary-measure-space scope is already covered by forthcoming MN26.

claims.statement: Conditional on family 332's real-ell_1 metric Markov cotype theorem and the exact finite cut-recovery argument, every Lipschitz map from any subset of any metric space X with finite Markov type-2 constant into ambient real L1(Omega,mu), for any positive measure space, extends with Lip(F)<=C_MN*12*sqrt(21)*M2(X)*Lip(f). The arbitrary-range, nonseparable-source conclusion follows from L1(mu)'s L-embeddedness and the finite-range global extension stage.
assumptions: Real-valued ambient L1; the stated cut formula does not establish the complex-valued case
Family-332 release theorem N2(ell_1)<=12*sqrt(21) is accepted as a premise
Exact finite cut encoding/recovery is valid for each finite set of real integrable range points
C_MN is the unspecified universal factor in Mendel-Naor Corollary 1.13
L1(mu) is L-embedded for the given positive measure space

overall_conclusion: The L-embedded compactness step is valid and removes the Komlos/separability bottleneck conditional on uniform global finite-range extensions. This is a standard globalization mechanism and does not establish a novel Hilbert-to-L1 extension result.
